A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GameFactory. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original generation experiments, quantitative ablations and dataset comparisons in Tables 2–6, and collision and racing demonstrations in Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results and adds an original-model output sequence to the qualitative comparison in Figure 8.

M1.justification: The action grouping, keyboard cross-attention, mouse concatenation, autoregressive generation, LoRA domain adapter, and multi-phase training procedure remain unchanged in Sections 4–5.

E1.justification: Both versions use GF-Minecraft, VPT Find Cave, open-domain scenes, and the appendix collision and racing scenarios. Figure 8's added reference uses the existing cherry-blossom scene and prompt.

E2.justification: Figure 8 newly includes an 'Original Model' qualitative reference alongside the retained multi-phase and one-phase outputs. Other evaluated comparator sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The 1B backbone, 5% test holdout, action subsets, resolution, training and sampling settings, and evaluation metrics are unchanged. The original model was already used as the reference for the Dom metric; its added visual sequence introduces no stated protocol revision.

E4.justification: Figure 8 extends the scene-generalization analysis with original-model frames, allowing direct visual assessment of style preservation. The action-module, dataset-bias, loss-scope, collision, and racing analyses otherwise remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The added qualitative reference introduces no uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: v3 adds six original-model frames in Figure 8. The existing multi-phase and one-phase frames are retained, and all numerical results in Tables 2–6 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The diffusion objective in Equation 1, latent and action definitions, and mathematical grouping constructions are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about GF-Minecraft, action control, autoregressive generation, and scene generalization through style-action decoupling.

C2.justification: The explanations of action-control behavior, style leakage, dataset bias, and loss-scope effects are unchanged. The conclusion's challenges and Appendices B–C's generalization interpretations and proposed applications are also retained.

D1.justification: Section 6.1 and Appendix A retain the implementation, hardware, hyperparameter, collection, and preprocessing details. Although v3 removes the abstract's availability sentence, the same project URL and Table 1 dataset-availability disclosure remain.

R1.justification: All 53 reference entries, the related-work discussion, and Table 1's research positioning are retained. Changed citation-page back-references reflect pagination only.

P1.justification: v3 corrects two grammatical articles in the abstract, qualifies the internship footnote, adds a funding acknowledgement, and removes a repeated availability sentence. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 8 gains an Original Model row with small spacing and arrow adjustments. Figure 13 moves from PDF page 13 to page 14, text and references reflow, and printed page numbers disappear; table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added original-model sequence in Figure 8 supplies the visual reference missing from v2's style-preservation comparison, making that claim easier to assess. This is a limited improvement in evidence presentation; quantitative validation, reproducibility information, and stated limitations remain unchanged.
